note: Taken Infernal spec talents from the Vol'jin builder. Inner Demon lasts 5s per Felfury consumed (5–30s). The training dummy is always treated as above 75% health. Rating conversions: 14 crit / 8 hit / 10 haste per 1%.

talents.name: Ruin
talents.effect: Spend 2 Felfury. Direct Shadowflame hit. While Inner Demon is up, extra 30% of that hit as a 3s DoT.

talents.name: Dark Magician
talents.effect: Ruin (and unused Sunder/Felwrath) refunds 20 Energy while Inner Demon is up.

talents.name: Wrath of Sargeras
talents.effect: +6% magic damage, +4% spell hit.

talents.name: Fel Apprentice
talents.effect: Fel Fireball applies Felstrike while Inner Demon is up.

talents.name: Felfire Adept
talents.effect: +20% Sargeron Smite crit chance.

talents.name: Gul'dan's Prodigy
talents.effect: Fel Fireball energy and cast time -15%.

talents.name: Felforged
talents.effect: Periodic damage 15% chance: next 3 Fel Fireballs have 30% reduced cast time for 8s.

talents.name: Fel Cannon
talents.effect: +20% Fel Fireball and Ruin crit vs enemies above 75% health.

talents.name: Felwrath
talents.effect: AoE Felfury spender. Omitted in stationary fights.

talents.name: Hidden Power
talents.effect: Spell damage +15% of Intellect and Spirit. Inner Demon: further +20% of Spirit to spell damage and crit rating.

talents.name: Black Magic
talents.effect: +20% Ruin and Bane of Chaos (Chaos) damage.

talents.name: Illidari Magi
talents.effect: Periodic damage 20% chance to generate 1 Felfury.

talents.name: Infernal
talents.effect: Pet cooldown. Omitted in stationary fights (Doomsayer chosen).

talents.name: Felbreak
talents.effect: Interrupt. Unused in stationary fights.

talents.name: Shadow Magi
talents.effect: Annihilation/Sunder cooldown reductions. Unused in stationary fights.

talents.name: Sculptor of Doom
talents.effect: 3 direct crits: next Ruin within 8s is instant (still costs 2 Felfury).

talents.name: Illidari Smiter
talents.effect: Fel Fireball crits generate 1 Felfury.

talents.name: The True Blessing
talents.effect: Annihilation grants Sculptor of Doom. Unused in stationary fights.

talents.name: Doomsayer
talents.effect: Sargeron Smite crits refund 1 Felfury. Smite +25% damage vs enemies above 75% health.

talents.name: Unphased
talents.effect: Spell penetration and Inner Demon pushback reduction. Unused at 0 boss resist / no pushback.

talents.name: Felshock
talents.effect: Direct Felfury-spender crits: Inner Demon +1s and target +3% chance to be hit for 12s.

talents.name: Fel Infusion
talents.effect: +3% raid crit and +3% personal crit (+6% on the player).

talents.name: Archimonde's Wrath
talents.effect: Felfury spenders: +1% crit per 10 Energy at cast.

talents.name: Man'ari Teachings
talents.effect: +100% critical damage (crits deal 250% instead of 150%).

talents.name: Nether Spirit
talents.effect: Spell crit rating += 20% of Spirit. Converted at 14 rating per 1%.

talents.name: Malice of Gul'dan
talents.effect: Direct crits 60% chance: apply Felstrike and Fragment of Malice (5 Energy, +10% crit for 5s).
